headline: Perplexity’s browser-backed search can ingest Mem0 outputs as authoritative context, creating medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risk; no direct write-conflict is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Mem0 is a knowledge-management agent with no documented isolation or provenance controls, and Perplexity runs browser-backed multi-hop search that can ingest external content into its context. If Mem0 outputs are copied or fed into Perplexity, attacker-controlled text can be treated as instructions. The pair lacks a documented shared-channel safeguard, so uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF Mem0 outputs are pasted into Perplexity prompts or uploaded documents
IF Perplexity treats retrieved text as instruction-bearing context without provenance tagging
mitigations: Add a fixed delimiter and instruction hierarchy to all Mem0 exports
Paste Mem0 output only into a read-only summary prompt
Disable browsing for prompts that include untrusted Mem0 content
Review Perplexity citations before acting on any retrieved instruction
requires-engineering: add provenance labels from Mem0 into downstream prompts

B_data_leakage.rationale: Mem0 is a memory store, so its outputs may contain retained user data, while Perplexity accepts uploaded PDFs/images and sends queries to vendor APIs/search providers. If Mem0 content is transferred into Perplexity, sensitive material can leave the local context and be processed by a third party. The profiles do not show a shared filesystem, but the upload/search path makes leakage plausible in default use.
conditions: IF Mem0 stores personal or confidential notes that are later copied into Perplexity
IF Perplexity uploads those notes or derived files to api.perplexity.ai or search providers
mitigations: Redact secrets from Mem0 before exporting to Perplexity
Use Perplexity only on synthetic or public examples
Turn off file uploads for any Mem0-derived material
Check whether the prompt contains personal data before sending
requires-engineering: segregate sensitive Mem0 memories into a separate vault

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Mem0 exposes no write or network surface in the profile, while Perplexity cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or execute shell commands. Their mutable-capability overlap is therefore minimal. The only plausible conflict is user-mediated content flow, which is not a write-write race and has small blast radius.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same document set but only one is allowed to edit
IF the operator manually copies outputs between them
mitigations: Keep Mem0 read-only in the workflow
Avoid simultaneous edits to the same artifact
Use separate working copies for each agent
Require manual review before any downstream write
requires-engineering: add locking around shared artifacts

D_cascading_error.rationale: Mem0 can surface remembered facts, and Perplexity’s search/RAG workflow can render or act on those facts with citations. If Perplexity treats Mem0 output as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade into user-facing answers. The pair has a clear A-to-B dependency path, but no evidence of autonomous external actions, so medium fits better than high.
conditions: IF Mem0 returns stale or incorrect memories
IF Perplexity uses those memories as primary evidence without cross-checking
mitigations: Ask Perplexity to verify Mem0 claims against sources
Mark Mem0 output as untrusted context
Require citations for every Mem0-derived claim
Spot-check high-impact answers before use
requires-engineering: add confidence scoring to Mem0 exports

E_compliance.rationale: Mem0’s profile does not specify residency or retention, while Perplexity documents vendor-hosted processing and uploads of documents/search context. That creates a possible compliance mismatch for regulated data, but the profiles do not show a specific PHI/EU-PII transfer or a documented residency conflict. Because the other agent is not cited for a specific jurisdictional restriction, the risk stays low.
conditions: IF regulated data stored in Mem0 is sent to Perplexity
IF the operator relies on Perplexity for data subject requests or retention guarantees
mitigations: Do not send regulated records from Mem0 to Perplexity
Use Perplexity only with non-sensitive summaries
Review vendor privacy terms before sharing personal data
Keep a separate workflow for deletion/export requests
requires-engineering: document residency and retention boundaries
